answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring every identity to post a forfeitable stake in escrow. A controller spinning up a thousand fake agents must fund each clone locked deposit, so flooding costs climb past any profit horizon. Peers slash that bond when they catch duplicated behavioral fingerprints or shared signing keys. The stake is no ivory-tower abstraction; it is a real, losable asset. Attestation acts like a juniper gripping soil, holding only while the identity stays genuinely independent.
